name: Complete DIBBS supplier registration
goal: Guide the owner through SAM.gov entity registration and CAGE registration. Glacier does not create accounts, enter credentials, submit forms, or verify identity.

config.prompt: Your step: Complete the business's SAM.gov entity registration and CAGE registration yourself. Open https://sam.gov/entity-registration and https://cage.dla.mil/. Use your own credentials and complete any identity/entity checks personally. Glacier will not create accounts, enter passwords, submit registrations, or verify identity. After registration, return to Glacier and approve this step to record that you completed it.

config.template:
The owner confirmed in run {run} that SAM.gov and CAGE registration steps were completed. Glacier did not create accounts, enter credentials, or submit registrations.

{summary}
